briefing.headline: Two Datadog PMM reqs and an AWS marketing-analytics BA just landed — those, plus the Boston AWS PMM, are today's real shots.
briefing.focus: Spend today on the roles that sit at the intersection of both your lanes: AWS's Integrated Demand Center BA (marketing funnel analytics, SQL, dashboards — literally your resume) and Datadog's fresh Journey Monitoring PMM. Then hit the two Boston-anchored plays (AWS Storage PMM in Boston, CarGurus B2B Specialist) before they age out. Skip the Amazon 'AMZ#####' business-analyst postings entirely — those are PERM immigration notices, not real external openings.

ranked.why: Marketing demand-gen analytics at AWS — measurement frameworks, dashboards, campaign insight — merges both your lanes at the country's largest H-1B sponsor.
Fresh core-PMM req at Datadog: own GTM for one capability, not a whole portfolio — right scope for 6 yrs, and Datadog sponsors heavily.
The only PMM role in Boston at a top-tier sponsor; six weeks old but worth burning an application on before it closes.
Brand-new sales ops analyst req, clean 0-3yr analyst lane, SQL/Salesforce-native; Gusto is large and established enough to sponsor.
'Associate' title hides a genuine GTM strategy/ops seat at Datadog — level-appropriate, analyst-lane, and the keyword score missed it.
Scored 60 only because the JD is HTML-mangled — it's a Stripe PMM role in payments/stablecoins, the closest thing here to your banking/fintech domain.
Literal 'Marketing Analyst' title, remote-US, funnel/self-serve analytics — the single cleanest title match to your dual profile.
Boston HQ, B2B, 'Specialist' level, public company that sponsors — geographically the best-odds application on this list.
Same Datadog PMM bar but AI/Kubernetes/GPU positioning — you'd be selling to infra engineers with no infra background.
AWS Analytics PMM — your MBA in analytics/ML gives you a real content angle most PMM applicants can't fake.
Promotions analytics is marketing analytics by another name: A/B tests, incrementality, campaign ROI — and it's fresh this week.
Second Datadog GTM S&O associate seat, not previously pushed; apply to this and the Channels one as separate shots.
B2B PMM inside Amazon's $35B business unit — closest Amazon PMM req to your actual B2B positioning/enablement work.
GTM strategy/planning at a high-growth AI revenue company; pipeline-velocity and conversion analysis is exactly your funnel vocabulary.
Customer stories and case studies is a named skill on your resume — ATS scored this at 67 but the content match is near-perfect.
Fraud-prevention PMM at Stripe — banking/fintech domain plus positioning; competitive, but your background is genuinely differentiated here.
Lending product lifecycle marketing, remote-US, fintech — Eloqua/HubSpot experience transfers directly to the email/nurture stack.
Remote-US GTM analytics with SQL and funnel metrics at the core; Lattice is mid-size, so confirm sponsorship before investing time.
Second Boston CarGurus seat — brand-side rather than B2B demand gen, so a weaker content fit but a strong location one.
ABM is the first skill on your resume and this req is pure ABM program design at AWS; only downside is Arlington, VA.
Specialist-level, remote-US, at a large sponsor — lifecycle/email is adjacent to your Eloqua work and the level is right, not senior.
Explicitly 'Associate' at Datadog and only scored 55 on ATS keywords — under-rated entry point into a company that sponsors.
Remote-US GTM business ops at a NYSE-listed company; solid analyst-lane fit, though you've seen it before and passed once.
End-to-end multi-channel campaign ownership with promo incentives — right level, though consumer rather than B2B.
ABM plus partner marketing at AWS, not previously surfaced — same skill core as the ABM req with less internal competition.
Associate-level marketing automation ops — your Eloqua/HubSpot depth maps cleanly; Yext is public but smaller, so sponsorship is worth checking.
Boston-based business analyst role, but SimpliSafe is a mid-size consumer hardware company with a thin sponsorship track record.
Established public company that sponsors, but this is developer-PLG lifecycle work — further from your enterprise B2B motion than the title suggests.
Demand gen in a fintech/legal product — good domain fit, but Carta is private and mid-size and you've seen this one already.
Email/segmentation at AWS scale fits your Eloqua background, but it's a single-channel role that narrows you after six years of full-funnel work.
Near-identical to the Channels & Alliances associate req already ranked above and repeatedly surfaced — apply once, not three times.
Right level and a sponsoring company, but it's paid-LinkedIn execution only — a step sideways from strategic PMM work.
Same team as the fresher Gusto sales ops analyst but narrowed to health insurance; take the broader req instead.
Boston and a strong local brand, but 'Product Owner, Sales Systems' is a systems/backlog role, not marketing or analysis.
Waltham, MA option makes it locally viable and the fit score of 61 is too harsh, but confirm this isn't a customer-facing services seat.
Legitimate BA II title and level, but workforce/capacity planning has no marketing surface — a lane-widener, not a lane-builder.
